content.title: Here's why IBM is buying Confluent
content.description:
Confluent (CFLT) shares are surging after it was announced IBM (IBM) would buy the company in a deal valued at $11 billion. Confluent co-founder and CEO Jay Kreps and IBM Senior vice president of software and chief commercial officer Rob Thomas tell Market Catalysts Host Julie Hyman about the deal and why it makes sense for both companies.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
